Pani.information: Gandum mein pani ki zaroorat fasal ki halat aur ilaqay ke mutabiq dekhi jati hai. Pani ki kami wheat production ko kam kar sakti hai.
Pani.source: Pakistan Agricultural Research Council (PARC) - Wheat Program

Khaad.information: Gandum mein khaad ka istemal fasal ki zaroorat aur input management ke mutabiq karna chahiye.
Khaad.source: Punjab Agriculture Department - Wheat Research Institute

Spray.information: Gandum ki fasal ko baqaidgi se check karein. Agar kungi ya rust ki alamat nazar aayen to local Agriculture Department ya Pest Warning ke maahir ke mashware se munasib fungicide spray karein.
Spray.source: Punjab Agriculture Department - Wheat Rust Advisory

Spray.information: Punjab Agriculture Department ke PPRI data mein wheat Yellow Rust ke liye propiconazole 1 mL per litre pani listed hai. Spray se pehle local agricultural expert aur product label ki hidayat check karein.

Punjab Agriculture Department ke PPRI data mein wheat Brown Rust ke liye propiconazole 1 mL per litre pani listed hai. Spray se pehle local agricultural expert aur product label ki hidayat check karein.

Gandum mein jari bootiyon ko control karna zaroori hai. Suitable weed killer ka intekhab local agricultural expert ke mashware se karein. Tez hawa, dhund ya barish mein spray na karein aur spray ke liye munasib nozzle istemal karein.
Spray.source: Punjab Agriculture Department - Wheat Weeds Advisory, December 2025

Bimari.information: Gandum mein rust, smut, bunt, blast aur kuch viral diseases aham bimariyon mein shamil hain. Bimari ki sahi pehchan ke liye nishaniyan check karna zaroori hai.
Bimari.source: Punjab Agriculture Department - Wheat Research Institute

Growth.information: Gandum ki behtar paidawar ke liye waqt par kasht, munasib input management, pani aur weeds ka control important hain.
Growth.source: Pakistan Agricultural Research Council (PARC) - Wheat Program
